pages.text: Every organ's genes trace back to one of the $(reset)seven genomes$(reset). Right-click a creature with the $(reset)Sample Collector$(reset) to file it into a genome (priority: Dragon > Boss > Explosive > Aberrant > Ender > Undead > Warm-blooded).$(br2)$(bold)Two laws:$(reset)$(li)The stronger the genome, the $(reset)higher its base purity and potential$(reset) (Dragon 90 > Warm-blooded 45).$(li)The stronger the genome, the $(reset)harder it is to bear$(reset) — narrower compatibility and heavier rejection.

pages.title: Data Card ① Warm-blooded / Undead
pages.text: $(bold)$(reset)Warm-blooded genome$(reset)$(li)Base purity: 45$(li)Collect rate: 85%$(li)Organ compat: 75 - 95$(li)Rejection factor: 0.8 (best fit)$(br2)$(bold)$(reset)Undead genome$(reset)$(li)Base purity: 55$(li)Collect rate: 70%$(li)Organ compat: 60 - 85$(li)Rejection factor: 1.0$(br2)Warm-blooded is the most forgiving start: highest collect rate, widest compat, lowest rejection — suited to a first full build.

pages.title: Data Card ② Explosive / Aberrant
pages.text: $(bold)$(reset)Explosive genome$(reset) (Creeper)$(li)Base purity: 60$(li)Collect rate: 55%$(li)Organ compat: 45 - 70$(li)Rejection factor: 1.1$(br2)$(bold)$(reset)Aberrant genome$(reset) (spiders/slimes/blazes and other unnatural foes)$(li)Base purity: 65$(li)Collect rate: 45%$(li)Organ compat: 45 - 70$(li)Rejection factor: 1.15$(br2)Aberrants include many functional mobs (spiders, blazes, guardians) — a common source for trait and passive builds.

pages.title: Data Card ③ Ender / Boss / Dragon
pages.text: $(bold)$(reset)Ender genome$(reset)$(li)Base purity: 70$(li)Collect rate: 40%$(li)Organ compat: 35 - 60$(li)Rejection factor: 1.3$(br2)$(bold)$(reset)Boss genome$(reset) (Wither / Warden)$(li)Base purity: 85$(li)Collect rate: 20%$(li)Organ compat: 30 - 55$(li)Rejection factor: 1.5$(br2)$(bold)$(reset)Dragon genome$(reset) (Ender Dragon)$(li)Base purity: 90$(li)Collect rate: 25%$(li)Organ compat: 25 - 50$(li)Rejection factor: 1.6 (hardest fit)
Selection: for peak numbers choose Dragon/Boss, for stability choose Warm-blooded/Undead; transplanting several organs of one group can trigger Ecosystem Synergy — see next page.
